coreMemory.english: n. the way in which things are not the same
coreMemory.structure: make a difference /meɪk ə ˈdɪfrəns/（产生影响）；difference between /ˈdɪfrəns bɪtwin/（……之间的差别）；notice a difference /noʊtəs ə ˈdɪfrəns/（注意到差异）；big difference /bɪɡ ˈdɪfrəns/（很大差异）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use difference with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of difference in context；❌ translate difference word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “make a difference”

commonErrors.wrong: use difference with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈdɪfrəns wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of difference in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈdɪfrəns ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “make a difference”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz meɪk ə ˈdɪfrəns/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。

coreMemory.example: Ten focused minutes can make a difference.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 专注的十分钟也能带来改变。

antonyms.usage: 在本卡核心义下与 difference 构成最直接的语义对比；实际使用前仍要核对词性和句型。
